runs.text: Greetings from Paul and Timothy
Philippians 1:1–2
Philemon 1:1–3
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

runs.text: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae:

runs.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
runs.originalText: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

runs.text: Thanksgiving and Prayer
1 Corinthians 1:4–9
Philippians 1:3–11
We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
runs.originalText: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

runs.text: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
runs.originalText: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints —

runs.text: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel
runs.originalText: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel

runs.text: that has come to you.
runs.originalText: that has come to you.

runs.text: All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
runs.originalText: All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.

runs.text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

runs.originalText: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

runs.text: The Supremacy of the Son
Hebrews 1:1–14
The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
runs.originalText: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

runs.text: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
runs.originalText: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

runs.text: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
runs.originalText: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.

runs.text: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
runs.originalText: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

runs.text: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
runs.originalText: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,

runs.text: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
runs.originalText: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.

runs.text: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
runs.originalText: Once you were alienated  from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.

runs.text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
runs.originalText: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence —

runs.text: under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

runs.text: Paul’s Suffering for the Church
2 Corinthians 11:16–33
Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
runs.originalText: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

runs.originalText: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,

runs.originalText: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

runs.text: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
runs.originalText: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

runs.originalText: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect

runs.text: in Christ.
